stem: Represent the ordered pairs (3, 5) and (5, 3) graphically in the coordinate plane. Tap each point. Are they the same point?
solution: Plot (3, 5): go 3 along the x-axis, then 5 up.
Plot (5, 3): go 5 along the x-axis, then 3 up.
The two points are in different places.
Each ordered pair is represented by one and only one point, so different points mean different pairs.
The first projections 3 and 5 differ, so the pairs are not equal: (3, 5) ≠ (5, 3).

hints.text: Each ordered pair gives one point. Check that both pairs have been plotted.
Only the two pairs listed are plotted. For each one, move along x by the first number, then up by the second.
Both numbers in each pair are positive, so both moves go right along x and up along y.
